what: a frost drake: a small wingless dragon, a long low four-legged reptile built like a heavy lizard, with no wings at all. It has a short blunt horned head, a short thick neck, a long body carried close to the ground on four sprawled clawed legs, and a long tail. A single row of clear icicle spikes runs down its back from the head to the tail tip, and frost crusts its scales.
colours: white and pale ice-blue scales, clear pale blue icicle spikes, a white frosted belly, pale blue eyes, white frosty breath.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it stalks forward low to the ground with one front claw lifted to strike, its head thrust forward and its jaws open, breathing out one short puff of white frost no longer than its own head, its tail curled up behind it.
must_show: a wingless four-legged dragon, low like a lizard
white and pale ice-blue scales
a row of icicle spikes down the back
a small puff of frost at the jaws

what: a young black dragon: a lean, half-grown western dragon, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a lizard, with a slim neck, a narrow skull-like head and a thin whip tail. Its two wings are small and folded shut, lying closed along its back like a furled umbrella. It has two short pale horns on its head. Its scales are glossy black all over, the head, neck, body, legs, wings and tail alike.
colours: glossy black scales with dark grey highlights, a dull grey belly, pale bone-grey horns, yellow eyes, bright acid yellow-green spit.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its body is horizontal, like a stalking cat's. Its front legs are bent so its chest is low, its neck is stretched straight forward and its jaws are wide open, squirting one short straight spurt of bright yellow-green liquid out of its mouth, the spurt no longer than its own head. Its wings stay folded shut on its back and its thin tail lashes up behind.
must_show: a lean black dragon with all four feet on the ground
short pale horns
small wings folded shut (a young dragon)
a short spurt of yellow-green acid at the jaws

what: a sea dragon spawn: a young sea serpent, one long thick scaled snake-like body with a dragon's head. It has no legs, no feet, no arms and no wings. The head is a dragon's: a long toothy snout, two short horns and a pair of wide webbed fin-frills at the cheeks. A tall spiny webbed fin runs along its back like a sail, and its tail ends in a broad flat fish fin.
colours: dark teal and sea-grey scales on the back, a pale cream belly, pale yellow fin webbing with dark teal spines, yellow eyes, white water.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It has no limbs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its body rears up in one tall S-shaped coil with a single loop below, the head raised high at the top left with jaws open, spitting one short thick jet of white water no longer than its own head; the finned tail tip curls up at the right. It floats in empty air with nothing under it.
must_show: a legless, wingless serpent body in a rearing coil
a dragon's head with cheek fins
a spiny sail fin along the back and a fish-fin tail
dark teal and grey scales with a pale belly
a short jet of white water at the jaws

what: a young red dragon: a lean, half-grown western dragon, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a lizard, with a slim neck, a wedge-shaped head and a thin tail. Its two wings are small and folded shut, lying closed along its back like a furled umbrella. It has two short straight horns pointing backward and a low row of small spines down its neck. Its scales are bright scarlet all over, the head, neck, body, legs, wings and tail alike.
colours: bright scarlet-red scales, a paler orange-red belly, short black horns, black claws, yellow eyes, orange and yellow fire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its body is horizontal, like a stalking cat's. It strides forward with its head lifted proudly on its slim neck and its jaws wide open, shooting one short jet of orange flame straight out of its mouth, the flame joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its wings stay folded shut on its back and its thin tail lashes behind.
must_show: a lean scarlet-red dragon with all four feet on the ground
small wings folded shut and short horns (a young dragon)
a short jet of fire joined to the open mouth
must_not_show: ball of flame hiding the body
loose flame away from the mouth

what: an adult blue dragon: a full-grown, powerful western dragon, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a deep chest, a long thick neck, a long heavy tail and two great bat-like wings. Its head carries one single large ivory horn rising from the tip of its snout, and a pair of wide frilled fins at the cheeks. A row of tall spines runs down its neck and back. Its scales are dark royal blue all over.
colours: dark royal-blue scales, a paler steel-blue belly, dark blue wing membranes, an ivory nose horn, yellow eyes, one bright electric-yellow lightning bolt.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its long body is horizontal. Both great wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its long neck is arched up and forward and its jaws are wide open, and one short, thick, jagged zigzag bolt of bright yellow lightning shoots straight out of its mouth to the left, joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its heavy tail is swung up behind.
must_show: a powerful dark-blue dragon with all four feet on the ground
both great wings raised and spread open (an adult)
one large horn on the snout and frilled cheeks
tall back spines
a short yellow zigzag lightning bolt at the jaws

what: an adult red dragon: a full-grown, massive western dragon, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a deep barrel chest, a long thick neck, a long heavy tail and two great bat-like wings. It has two long horns sweeping backward from its head, spiked cheek frills, and a row of tall black-tipped spines down its neck and back. Its scales are dark blood-red all over, and its throat, chest and belly are armoured in broad golden-yellow plates.
colours: dark blood-red scales, golden-yellow belly plates, dark red wing membranes, long black horns, black-tipped spines, yellow eyes, deep orange fire with a bright yellow core.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, drawn small and standing in the right-hand two thirds of the picture: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its long body is horizontal. Both great wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its long neck is arched up and forward and its jaws are wide open, with one short thick tongue of fire bursting from its mouth to the left, joined to the mouth, no longer than its own head but just as thick, deep orange with a bright yellow core, ending in a ragged point. The fire stops well short of the edge: the whole left quarter of the picture is empty backdrop. Its heavy tail is swung up behind.
must_show: a massive dark-red dragon with all four feet on the ground
golden-yellow throat and belly plates
both great wings spread open (an adult)
long swept-back horns and tall spines
one short thick burst of orange fire joined to the mouth, as big as its head, wholly inside the picture
must_not_show: ball of flame hiding the body
fire reaching the edge of the picture

what: a young dragon: a lean, half-grown western dragon of the old Saint George kind, a four-legged reptile with a slim neck, a wedge-shaped head, a thin tail with an arrowhead tip and two small bat-like wings held half folded against its back. It has two short straight horns pointing backward and a low row of small spines down its neck. Its scales are bright emerald green all over, the head, neck, body, legs and tail alike.
colours: bright emerald-green scales, a pale yellow-green belly, green wings, short ivory horns, ivory claws, yellow eyes, orange and yellow fire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it prowls forward with its body low and one front claw reaching ahead, its neck stretched out and its jaws open with one short tongue of orange fire no longer than its own head, its small wings half folded and its thin tail curled up behind.
must_show: a lean bright-green dragon on four legs
small half-folded wings and short horns (a young dragon)
a plain green hide with no gold on it
a small tongue of fire at the jaws

what: a dread wyrm: a misgrown, sickly dragon that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard. It is plainly a dragon, a scaly reptile: it has a long thick scaly neck, a long narrow dragon's head with a long snout, two crooked grey horns of different lengths sweeping back from its skull, a long heavy tail as long as its body, and a ragged ridge of uneven spines running from its head to the tip of its tail. But it grew wrong. Its body is far too heavy for the rest of it: a swollen sagging barrel with loose folds of scaly hide hanging at the belly and throat, never muscular, carried on four short bowed legs. Its lower jaw is oversized and underslung and crowded with crooked fangs. Its two wings are stunted: two crumpled bat wings, each no bigger than its own head, standing half open on its shoulders, far too small to lift it. Its scales are diseased: dull grey-brown, the colour of wet peat, covered with big pale sickly yellow-grey blotches, each as large as its head, cracked and peeling. Its eyes burn orange.
colours: dull grey-brown scaly hide the colour of wet peat with big pale sickly yellow-grey blotches, a pale grey sagging belly, dark brown stunted wings, grey horns and spines, burning orange eyes, deep orange fire with a yellow core.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its body is horizontal: it lumbers forward on short bowed legs with its hunched back high and its belly sagging nearly to the ground, its long neck stretched forward and up so its horned head is held out well ahead of its chest, its oversized jaws gaping wide with one short thick jet of deep orange fire shooting straight out of its mouth, joined to the mouth, as long as its own head, its two stunted wings sticking up uselessly from its shoulders and its long heavy tail sweeping out behind.
must_show: plainly a dragon: long neck, long-snouted horned head, long tail, scales, on four legs
a bloated, sagging, misgrown body
stunted crumpled wings far too small for the body
an oversized jaw with crooked fangs
blotched diseased hide: grey-brown with big pale yellow-grey patches, not plain orange
fire from the jaws

what: an adult dragon: a full-grown, powerful western dragon of the Beowulf kind, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a deep chest, a long thick neck, a long heavy tail with an arrowhead tip and two great bat-like wings. It has two long horns sweeping backward from its head and a row of tall spines down its neck and back. Its scales are deep forest green, and its throat, chest and belly are armoured in broad bright gold plates.
colours: deep forest-green scales, bright gold throat and belly plates, dark green wing membranes, long ivory horns, ivory claws, yellow eyes, orange and yellow fire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its long body is horizontal. Both great wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its long neck is arched up and forward and its jaws are wide open, shooting one short thick jet of orange fire straight out of its mouth to the left, the fire joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its tail is swung up behind.
must_show: a powerful deep-green dragon with all four feet on the ground
a gold-plated throat and belly
both great wings raised and spread open (an adult)
two long swept-back horns and tall spines
a short jet of fire joined to the mouth
must_not_show: ball of flame hiding the body
fire reaching the edge of the picture

what: an elder dragon: a very old, enormous, heavily armoured western dragon, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a vast deep chest, a neck as thick as a tree trunk, two great bat-like wings and a long tail that ends in one heavy round knob of bone studded with spikes. Its head is ringed by a crown of many long horns fanning out behind the skull, and a beard of long horn spikes hangs under its chin. Thick ridged armour plates cover its shoulders and back. Its scales are dark bronze, each edged in gold.
colours: dark bronze and brown-gold scales with bright gold edges, a pale gold belly, dark bronze wing membranes, black horns with gold tips, yellow eyes, orange and yellow fire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its long heavy body is horizontal. Both great wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its horned head is lowered on its thick neck with the jaws open, shooting one short thick burst of orange fire straight out of its mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its tail is lifted high behind it with the spiked knob at the top, ready to smash down.
must_show: an enormous dark bronze-and-gold dragon with all four feet on the ground
a crown of many long horns round the head
a beard of horn spikes under the chin
a heavy spiked knob at the end of the tail
both great wings spread open
heavier and more armoured than the adult dragon
must_not_show: ball of flame hiding the body
wing cut off by the edge of the picture

what: Fafnir, the dragon of the Norse saga: a colossal wingless crawling dragon, a lindworm, with no wings at all. He has an immensely long, thick serpent body carried low on four short, massive clawed legs, a huge heavy head with a jutting jaw, long venom-dripping fangs and a mane of long black horns sweeping back from his skull, and a row of jagged black plates down his whole back. His scales are black, and his whole underside, from throat to tail, is crusted solid with the hoard he lies on: gold coins, gold rings and gems stuck fast between the scales like armour. A thick gold ring is clasped round one of his horns.
colours: black and dark iron-grey scales, a bright gold coin-crusted underside with a few ruby glints, black horns, a gold horn-ring, burning amber eyes, bright poison-green venom dripping from ivory fangs.
wears: He is a beast and wears nothing but the gold stuck to his belly and the gold ring on one horn.
holds: He is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: he crawls forward with his long body in one great S-bend, his chest and head reared up off the ground to show the gold-crusted belly, one huge front claw lifted to rend, jaws stretched wide open with bright green venom dripping from the fangs, his long tail coiled up high behind him.
must_show: a wingless crawling dragon with a long serpent body on four short legs
black scales
an underside crusted with gold coins and rings
a mane of long black horns
green venom dripping from the fangs
the most ornate and imposing dragon of the family

what: an ancient dragon: an immeasurably old western dragon whose colour has all gone, a gaunt, huge four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a long neck, a long tail and two vast bat-like wings whose trailing edges hang in ragged tatters. Its head is ringed by a crown of many long horns, some snapped short, and a long beard of icicles hangs from its chin and jaw. Its scales are hoary white and cracked like old ice all over, the head, neck, body, legs and tail alike, with hoarfrost thick on its back and shoulders.
colours: hoary bone-white and pale silver-grey scales, pale grey ragged wing membranes, pale ice-blue frost and icicles, grey horns, pale ice-blue eyes, white frost breath.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its long gaunt body is horizontal. Both vast ragged wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its long neck curves forward and down and its jaws are wide open, breathing one short thick plume of white frost straight out of its mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its long tail trails in a curve behind.
must_show: a gaunt hoary-white dragon with all four feet on the ground
vast wings with ragged, tattered edges
a crown of many horns
a beard of icicles
white frost breath, no fire
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: a lesser undead dragon: the long-dead, dried-out corpse of a dragon raised from the grave, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs, with a long neck, a horned head, a long tail and two bat-like wings. It is a starved, sunken carcass, never a living animal: ash-grey leathery dead hide is stretched tight over the bones of the head, neck, legs and tail, so the spine, hip bones and shoulder blades jut out. All along its side the hide is gone and the whole ribcage stands bare: a long row of big ivory ribs with dark empty space between them. Its wings are little more than bare finger bones with a few torn rags of grey membrane hanging from them. Its eyes are blank milky white and its lower jaw hangs slack.
colours: ash-grey and dull brown-grey dead hide, a bare ivory ribcage and ivory horns, torn dark grey rags of wing membrane, blank white eyes, pale grey breath.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are on the ground and its body is horizontal. It lurches forward with its head hanging low on a drooping neck and its slack jaws open, breathing out one short puff of pale grey vapour no longer than its own head, its ragged wings drooping half open and its tail dragging.
must_show: a dragon's sunken grey corpse on four legs, still partly covered in dead hide
a whole bare ribcage showing along the side
wings in rags and holes
blank white eyes
no fire

what: a lich dragon spawn: the small bare skeleton of a young dragon, a four-legged reptile skeleton, nothing but clean white bones with empty air between them: no hide, no flesh and no skin anywhere. Its skull is a dragon's: long, narrow and flat, with a long toothed snout and two short horns at the back. It has a slim neck of vertebrae, a long narrow ribcage slung under a level spine, two bone front legs and two bone hind legs all of the same length, and a long thin bone tail. Rising from its shoulder blades are two small wing skeletons: each is just four long thin bare finger bones fanned out like the ribs of an umbrella that has lost its cloth, with nothing but empty air between the bones. Two small cold blue lights burn in its eye sockets.
colours: clean ivory and pale grey bone, cold pale blue eye lights, a pale blue frost breath.
wears: It is a skeleton beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it walks on all four legs with its two front feet and its two hind feet all touching the ground and its spine level and horizontal. Its skull is thrust forward with the bone jaws wide open, breathing one short puff of pale blue frost no longer than its own skull, its two bare bone wing-fans raised above its back and its thin bone tail whipping behind.
must_show: a small dragon skeleton with all four feet on the ground, bare bone everywhere
wings of bare bone spokes with no skin between them
short horns and a slim build (young)
cold blue lights in the eye sockets
must_not_show: front legs held up off the ground

what: a spectral dragon: the ghost of a dragon, a pale phantom drifting in the air. What is left of it is a horned dragon's head with open jaws, a long curving neck, a deep ribbed chest and two great spread bat-like wings. Behind the wings the chest narrows at once into one long, ragged, tapering tail of pale mist, three times as long as the head, that streams away to the right like the tail of a comet, fraying into five or six long thin streamers at its end, joined to the body. Its whole form is pale and milky like frosted glass, with the darker lines of its ribs showing through the chest, and a ball of cold blue-white fire burning inside the ribcage.
colours: pale milky white and pale aqua-blue ghost body, darker grey-blue rib lines, bright blue-white ghost fire in the chest, eyes and jaws.
wears: It is a ghost and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it swoops level through empty air toward the left with both wings spread wide above it, bent sharply at the wrist like two tall arches, its neck curved like an S, its jaws open with one short lick of blue-white ghost fire no longer than its own head, and behind the wings its body is only the long pale tail of mist streaming away to the right, wholly inside the picture.
must_show: a pale ghostly dragon: head, neck, ribbed chest and wings clear
behind the wings the body is one tapering tail of mist and streamers: nothing hangs beneath it
blue-white fire glowing inside the chest
pale milky white and aqua-blue all over
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: a dracolich: the towering skeleton of a great old dragon, walking on all four legs, made only of heavy bare bones with empty air between them and no flesh, no hide and no muscle anywhere. It has a massive dragon skull with a crown of many long horns, a long neck of thick vertebrae, a great open cage of ribs, four heavy bone legs and a long bone tail. Its two great wings are bare bone fingers with long tattered black strips of old membrane hanging between them. Bands of gold are clasped round its horns and a heavy gold chain hangs round its neck bones. Inside the open ribcage, where the heart would be, sits one large glowing gem, and two small flames burn in its eye sockets.
colours: aged ivory and yellow-brown bone on every part of the body, tattered black wing membranes, gold horn bands and a gold chain, one bright poison-green gem and two poison-green eye flames, pale grey breath.
wears: It wears gold bands on its horns and a heavy gold chain round its neck; nothing else.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its bone feet are planted on the ground and its spine is horizontal, like a huge lizard's. Both tattered wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its crowned skull is thrust forward on the long bone neck with the jaws open, breathing one short puff of pale grey mist no longer than its own skull. Its bone tail is curled up behind.
must_show: a great dragon skeleton with all four feet on the ground, ivory-brown bare bone
a crown of many long horns with gold bands
tattered black membrane hanging in the bone wings
a green gem glowing inside the ribcage
green fire in the eye sockets
far grander and more ornate than the lich dragon spawn
must_not_show: hide or flesh on the body
cloud of mist round the body

what: an abyssal dragon: a dragon bred in hell, half dragon and half demon, a huge four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a deep chest, a thick neck, a long tail ending in a barbed spike, and two great ragged bat-like wings. Its head carries two massive ridged ram's horns curling round the sides of the skull and a row of smaller spikes along the jaw. The claws on its front feet are enormously long and curved like sickle blades. Its hide is rough and dark like cooled slag, split all over by glowing cracks of molten orange, and its eyes and throat glow the same molten orange.
colours: dark charcoal-grey and black slag hide, glowing molten orange-red cracks, black ram's horns, black claws, dark red wing membranes, orange-red hellfire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its long body is horizontal, its long sickle claws splayed out in front. Both ragged wings are raised straight up and spread wide open above its back. Its horned head is thrust forward with the jaws wide open, shooting one short thick jet of orange-red fire straight out of its mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its barbed tail is arched up over its back.
must_show: a dragon with all four feet on the ground and a dark slag-grey hide
glowing molten orange cracks all over the hide
big curling ram's horns (a demon's)
very long sickle claws
both ragged wings spread open
hellfire joined to the jaws
must_not_show: ball of flame hiding the body

what: a draugr: the walking corpse of a Norse warrior from a burial mound, a big heavy-set dead man with a swollen belly under his tunic and thick limbs. It is dead flesh, never living colour: the face, arms, hands and bare feet are all the same dark slate-grey, almost black, with a cold dark-blue bruised tinge, like a body long in the ground. He has a gaunt sunken face with hollow cheeks, blank white eyes with no pupils, a long tangled grey-white beard in two braids and long matted grey-white hair. He has the realistic proportions of a big adult man with a small head.
colours: very dark slate-grey dead skin with a dark blue-black tinge, grey-white hair and beard, a rotted dull brown wool tunic, a plain dark iron arm-ring, blank white eyes.
wears: He wears a rotted, torn, long-sleeved brown wool tunic that covers his chest and belly and hangs to the knee, with a rope belt, and one plain iron ring round his upper arm; no armour, no helmet, bare feet.
holds: His hands are empty: two open clawing hands with long black nails, holding nothing.
pose: On two legs, he lurches forward in mid-stride with one foot ahead of the other and his weight on the front foot, both thick arms stretched straight out ahead of him to seize and wrestle, fingers spread, head lowered and mouth open in a groan.
must_show: a big bloated dead man with death-blue skin, face included
long grey-white braided beard and hair (a Norseman)
rotted tunic, no armour
empty grasping hands
blank white eyes

what: a soul eater spawn: a small beast of the kind of Ammit, the Egyptian devourer, one single animal on four legs made of three animals joined in a row. Its head is a crocodile's: a long flat scaly snout full of teeth. Its neck, chest and two front legs are a lion's, with a shaggy tawny mane and clawed paws. Its rear half is a hippopotamus's: a fat round hairless grey rump on two thick stubby hind legs with a short thin tail. It is about the size of a big dog.
colours: a dark grey-brown scaly crocodile head with ivory teeth, a tawny golden-brown lion mane and forelegs, a slate-grey hippopotamus rump, pale yellow eyes.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it lunges forward with its front paws stretched out and its crocodile jaws stretched wide open to swallow, its fat hindquarters low and pushing.
must_show: one animal on four legs
a crocodile's long toothy snout for a head
a lion's mane and front paws
a fat grey hippopotamus rump
small, the size of a dog
must_not_show: long lion tail with a tuft

what: a ghast: a gaunt, hairless, corpse-eating ghoul, a starved man-shaped creature with long thin limbs and every rib showing. It is dead flesh, ash-white and corpse-grey, never living pink. It has a bald skull-like head with sunken red eyes, pointed ears, no nose, and a wide lipless mouth of long sharp yellow fangs. Its arms hang past its knees and end in very long hooked black claws.
colours: ash-white and pale corpse-grey skin with dark grey shadows, black claws, red eyes, yellow fangs, a dirty dark brown rag.
wears: It wears only a torn dirty brown rag wrapped round its hips to the knee; no armour.
holds: Its hands are empty: long black claws holding nothing.
pose: On two legs, it crouches with both knees deeply bent and its back hunched, leaning far forward on the balls of its feet, one long clawed arm raking forward and the other drawn back, its fanged mouth stretched wide open.
must_show: a gaunt hairless ghoul with ash-white skin
very long black claws
a wide mouth of long fangs
red eyes
crouched and hunched, leaner and more feral than a zombie

what: a dread wraith: an ancient wraith lord, a towering hooded ghost made of drifting tatters of black cloth with nothing inside, only two cold pale lights for eyes in the empty hood. A tall crown of jagged black iron spikes sits on top of the hood. Two broad spiked black iron shoulder plates sit where the cloth hangs widest, with broken iron chains hanging from them. Two long sleeves of torn black cloth end in long thin shadowy claws. Below the waist the cloth has no hem: it tears into long ragged wisps that stream away to the lower right, joined to the body.
colours: black and deep grey cloth, a black iron crown and shoulder plates with dull silver edges, dark iron chains, pale icy blue-white eye lights.
wears: It is an empty tattered hooded shroud with a spiked iron crown on the hood and two spiked iron shoulder plates.
holds: Its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It lunges to the left through the air, its whole shape one slanting curve leaning far over to the left: the crowned hood is thrust forward at the upper left, one long arm is stretched far out ahead to the left with the claws spread to seize, the other arm is drawn back and raised high behind it at the upper right with the claws hooked, the chains swing back, and the tattered lower half streams away to the lower right in long ragged wisps. The two arms are at different heights and point in different directions.
must_show: empty hood with two pale eye lights
a tall spiked black iron crown on the hood
spiked iron shoulder plates
ragged black cloth, trailing wisps streaming to one side
a lunging lopsided pose: one claw reaching ahead, one raised behind, not a symmetrical T
plainly a grander wraith than the common one
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body
arms held straight out to both sides
robe hanging to a level hem

what: a soul eater: a tall, starved phantom made of solid black shadow, with no cloth and no hood on it. Its head is a long crocodile's snout made of shadow, gaping wide, lined with long pale ivory teeth, with two small white eyes. Its neck is long and thin. Its chest is an open cage of thin black ribs, and shut inside the ribcage is one ball of pale gold light the size of a melon: the souls it has eaten.
